notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.emptyHint: Top-ups, approvals, ticket replies and alerts show up here.
notifications.errorHint: Check your connection and try again.

WALLET_LOW_BALANCE.title: Wallet balance is low
WALLET_LOW_BALANCE.body: The balance is {{balance}}, under your alert level of {{threshold}}.

TOPUP_REJECTED.title: Top-up rejected
TOPUP_REJECTED.body: The transfer of {{amount}} was not credited. The reason is on the wallet page.

TICKET_ANSWERED.title: Operations replied
TICKET_ANSWERED.body: There's a reply on your {{ticketType}} ticket.

TOPUP_AWAITING_APPROVAL.title: Top-up waiting for approval
TOPUP_AWAITING_APPROVAL.body: {{amount}} has been verified and needs a second person to approve it.

WALLET_ADJUSTMENT_AWAITING_APPROVAL.title: Wallet adjustment waiting for approval
WALLET_ADJUSTMENT_AWAITING_APPROVAL.body: An adjustment of {{amount}} needs someone else to approve it.

HARD_ALERT_RAISED.title: {{alertType}}
HARD_ALERT_RAISED.body: A new {{severity}} alert needs a look.

PAYOUT_POSTED.title: Payout sent
PAYOUT_POSTED.body: {{amount}} is on its way to the station's bank account.

BANK_ACCOUNT_CHANGE_APPROVED.title: Bank account change approved
BANK_ACCOUNT_CHANGE_APPROVED.body: Payouts now go to the new account.

BANK_ACCOUNT_CHANGE_REJECTED.title: Bank account change rejected
BANK_ACCOUNT_CHANGE_REJECTED.body: Payouts stay on the current account. Operations can tell you why.
